title: Query-Aware Source-Risk Triage for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.16564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines may omit a source's material relationship to the query. We study a pre-generation triage layer that treats this relationship as query dependent. The method routes canonical query families for enhanced review and assigns retrieved pages to pass, contextualize, exclude, or review. It combines a four-dimension page score, rank-discounted family aggregation, intent-preserving query mutations, and a family-held-out router. A single-coded pilot of 200 real URLs supplies provisional calibration anchors; a 20,000-row scenario with synthetic domain identifiers supports controlled workload analysis. An oracle page gate defines a risk-coverage target for a future learned classifier. The evaluation shows why page-level frequency cannot substitute for family-level exposure and quantifies how calibration changes scenario activation. translated_title: 面向检索增强生成的查询感知源风险分诊
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）流程可能会忽略来源与查询之间的重要关联。我们研究了一种预生成分诊层，该层将这种关联视为依赖于查询的方法。该方法对规范化查询族进行路由以进行增强审查，并为检索到的页面分配“通过”、“情境化”、“排除”或“审查”四种处置。该方法结合了四维页面评分、排名折扣的查询族聚合、保持意图的查询变体以及族留出路由器。一项针对200个真实URL的单人编码试点研究提供了临时校准锚点；包含合成域标识符的20,000行场景数据支持受控工作负载分析。一个Oracle页面门控为未来的学习型分类器定义了风险-覆盖目标。评估结果显示了为什么页面级频率无法替代族级暴露，并量化了校准如何改变场景激活。标注可靠性尚未测量，合成排名省略了再（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种查询感知的预生成分诊层，通过四维页面评分、排名折扣的查询族聚合和族留出路由器，对RAG检索到的来源进行风险分诊（通过/情境化/排除/审查），弥补了传统流程忽略来源与查询相关性的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a query-aware pre-generation triage layer for RAG that classifies retrieved sources into pass, contextualize, exclude, or review using four-dimension page scoring, rank-discounted family aggregation, and a family-held-out router, addressing the overlooked query-dependent relationship between sources and queries.
